notes.zh-CN: 对话导航条的刻度现在一样长：原先悬停和当前项会拉长到 14px，其他是 10px，看起来一排刻度长短不齐、还整体左移了 4px。现在长度统一，用颜色区分当前所在的位置。
notes.en: Every tick in the conversation rail is now the same length. Hovered and current ticks used to grow to 14px while the rest stayed at 10px, which read as a ragged column and shifted the active mark 4px left; the current position is shown by colour instead.
